ValidationRule.description: require Sales District for Account Group = ZCUS, ZINT, Z003, Z004
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias <> "sconn",
ISBLANK(TEXT(Sales_District__c)),
OR( ISPICKVAL( Account_Group__c, "Intra-Div & Inter-Co. - ZINT"), ISPICKVAL( Account_Group__c, "Third-Party - Cus. For Trade - Z003"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c, "Intra-Div & Inter-Co For Trade - Z004") ) )
